summary: CLPS Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, to furnish an updated corporate investor presentation for use at the Investor Summit Virtual Conference. The filing is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer providing a presentation for an investor conference, with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The presentation appears to be a standard corporate update with forward-looking statements and disclaimers. No deal terms are stated.
